description.value: Canco is a convenience store in Clinton, BC, a small interior town that serves as a waypoint for travellers on Highway 97. Tagged as shop=convenience in OSM, it provides the kind of grab-and-go supplies that touring cyclists passing through a rural community depend on. The auto-discovered Facebook page suggests a possible historical connection to a Shell fuel station and budget food store at the same location.

The auto-discovered Facebook URL points to 'clintonbudgetfoodsshell', a name that differs significantly from 'Canco', suggesting either a rebrand or a mismatched URL; the Facebook page itself returned a temporary block on all subpages, yielding no usable business content. All amenity fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags, and most must be left null.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible convenience store in a rural BC community with OSM opening hours; useful resupply point for touring cyclists despite limited amenity data.
enrichment_extras.notes: V0K1K0 resolves to Clinton, BC. If this is a Canco-branded fuel/convenience stop (as the name suggests), a Shell affiliation noted in the Facebook slug may be historical. A manual visit or direct outreach would resolve the name discrepancy and fill in amenity gaps.
